props.gloss_en: who taught 'passed through a river, made susceptible'? R' Yochanan: it is R' Yosei HaGelili
R' Yosei HaGelili: [the ben pekua] conveys food impurity, and needs hechsher
the Sages: it does not convey food impurity, because it is alive
the Sages: and whatever is alive does not convey food impurity
R' Yochanan: R' Yosei HaGelili and Beit Shammai said one thing
fish -- from when are they susceptible to impurity? Beit Shammai: from when they are caught
Beit Hillel: from when they die
R' Akiva: from when they can no longer live
what is between them [Beit Hillel and R' Akiva]? R' Yochanan: a convulsing fish is between them
tereifa signs developed in fish -- what [is the law]?
[the animal] expelled a nefel -- R' Yochanan: its fat is like the fat of a domesticated animal
Reish Lakish: its fat is like the fat of a wild animal
R' Yochanan: the airspace causes [it]
Reish Lakish: the months cause [it]
version 2: wherever its months were not completed it is nothing
version 2: he put his hand into the animal's womb, took fat of a live nine-month fetus and ate -- R' Yochanan: its fat is like domesticated-animal fat; the months cause
version 2: Reish Lakish: its fat is like wild-animal fat; the months and the airspace cause
the baraita: as the fat and two kidneys stated of the asham exclude the fetus, so every [offering] excludes the fetus
one slaughtered a tereifa and found in it a live nine-month fetus -- [the fetus] is permitted [by its own slaughter]
one slaughtered a tereifa and found in it a live nine-month fetus -- [the fetus] is forbidden
the Merciful One validated four simanim for it
Rav Chisda: one slaughtered a tereifa and found in it a live nine-month fetus -- it requires slaughter, and is liable in the foreleg, jaw and maw
Rav Chisda: and if it died -- it is pure from imparting impurity by carrying
Rava: 'requires slaughter' -- per whom? R' Meir. 'If it died it is pure from masa' -- per whom? the Rabbis
R' Chiya teaches: one slaughtered a tereifa and found in it a live nine-month fetus -- it requires slaughter ... and if it died it is pure from masa
Rava: R' Chiya speaks of where he had already found it dead
does it follow that Reish Lakish disputes him [R' Yochanan]?
he [Reish Lakish] was waiting for him and was silent
he was drinking and was silent
